title: ARCH-2 pre-registration: multi-scale narrow-unit candidate generation (C-PAIR V0.1) and RAG soft protection
status: ARCH2_PREREG_READY - no ARCH-2 experiment has been run

corrections_used.subdivision: experiments/ARCH2/arch2_subdivision.graded_region (cover 0.9, size 1.5); ARCH-1 graded() defect documented in docs/research/arch2/subdivision_correction.md
corrections_used.metrics: experiments/ARCH2/arch2_metrics.py (one-to-one matching, classes, protection metrics, Wilson CIs)

sheets.development: 10 frozen training sheets (in-sample B2 / M1 / M2 predictions in runs/r4c0/pred)
sheets.reporting: training and exposed are ALWAYS reported separately and per sheet; never pooled together

frozen: RAG main merge tau = 0.45 and median cost
change_policy: Each gate runs once. Only crash / implementation-bug fixes are allowed afterwards, each documented with the reason and the re-run kept next to the first output. No parameter, threshold, grid, rule or metric changes after any ARCH-2 result has been seen. Parameters chosen on training sheets are frozen in a committed file before any exposed-sheet run.

parameters_fixed_now.note: These values come from the design, not from any measurement; they are fixed here and NOT tuned in ARCH-2.

features: s_colour (smaller centre-line dE76 to the two neighbours, non-ink pixels)
parameters_selected_on_training.thresholds: per feature one PROTECT threshold and one INK-BAND threshold; PROTECT_SOFT iff all three exceed their PROTECT thresholds; MERGE iff s_colour and s_width are both below their INK-BAND thresholds; else UNCERTAIN
parameters_selected_on_training.threshold_grid: PROTECT thresholds at the training-sheet percentiles {10, 20, 30} of each feature over TRUE_NARROW candidates (joint grid 27 combinations); INK-BAND thresholds at percentiles {50, 70} over INK_BAND candidates (4 combinations)
parameters_selected_on_training.selection_rule: maximise training recall of protected TRUE_NARROW candidates subject to training false_protection_ink_band_share <= 0.30; ties -> fewer protected candidates. If no combination meets 0.30, PROTECT_SOFT is disabled (all such candidates become UNCERTAIN) and this is reported.
parameters_selected_on_training.lambda_selection_rule: maximise training post-merge 3-6 px recall subject to training small-instance over-seg increase <= 0.03 vs RAG_BOUNDARY_ONLY; ties -> smaller lambda
parameters_selected_on_training.freeze: selected values committed as experiments/ARCH2/arch2_freeze.json before any exposed-sheet run

measure: detection rate of 3-6 and 6-10 px instances (one-to-one, IoU >= 0.3)
localisation: IoU of matched pairs (median, quartiles)
candidates per class (TRUE_NARROW / INK_BAND / INCIDENTAL) per sheet
Oracle A and Oracle B of the 3-6 / 6-10 px instances on the graded subdivision
regions vs B2-only, merge time, peak RSS
gate1_candidate_generation.pass: on BOTH training and exposed: 3-6 px Oracle A >= 0.65 AND >= B2-only Oracle A + 0.10 (B2-only: training 0.45, exposed 0.64); regions <= 3x B2-only on every sheet
gate1_candidate_generation.stop: if not passed: STOP ARCH-2 after Gate 1, report whether detection or localisation failed; no parameter change

measure: base rates of the three classes
for the selected joint rule: precision, recall, FPR, FDR, false_protection_ink_band_share, each with Wilson 95% CI, training and exposed, per sheet
single-feature AUCs for reference only (never a gate)
gate2_discrimination.pass: exposed false_protection_ink_band_share <= 0.30 (point estimate) and protected TRUE_NARROW recall >= 0.30 on exposed
gate2_discrimination.stop_or_degrade: if not passed, Gate 3 still runs but with PROTECT_SOFT disabled (all non-MERGE candidates UNCERTAIN); the failure is reported

variants: V1 C-PAIR candidates in the subdivision, no protection
V2 C-PAIR + soft protection on ALL non-MERGE candidates (no discrimination)
V3 C-PAIR + discrimination + soft protection on PROTECT_SOFT only
measure: small-instance recall overall and per width group 3-6 / 6-10 / 10-20 / >20 px with instance counts and Wilson CIs
paired bootstrap 95% CI (2000 resamples, seed 20261029) of the per-instance recall difference V3 - V0 in the 3-6 and 6-10 px groups, exposed sheets
survival: protected TRUE_NARROW candidates whose instance is recovered
merge errors, under-merge fragments, initial-mixed (r4c0_gate3 classification)
large recall, small over-seg, pseudo-fragment count, regions
catastrophic merge (largest region > 1.5 x largest official instance)
gate3_rag_soft_protection.uncertainty_rule: with 44 training 3-6 px instances the training gate is judged on the point estimate and its CI is reported; on exposed (160 instances) the paired bootstrap lower bound of the 3-6 px difference must be > 0
gate3_rag_soft_protection.stop: if V3 fails, report which of V1 / V2 / V3 first loses the gain (generation, protection or discrimination); no re-tuning in ARCH-2

measure: 9 export checks (validate_pixel_vectors) with the label-free exporter on 13014 / 15076 for V0 and V3
uncertain-candidate review layer: every absorbed PROTECT_SOFT / UNCERTAIN candidate restorable pixel-exactly from the decision store
no use of ignore.npy or any label-derived mask in prediction or export (code check + test)

overall_success: Gates 1, 3 and 4 pass and Gate 2 passes (or Gate 3 passes with protection disabled, reported as a weaker result)
reproduction_plan: experiments/ARCH2/arch2_gate{1..4}.py to be written in the implementation step, each reading this file; outputs to experiments/ARCH2/gate{1..4}/ (non-restricted JSON/CSV) and runs/arch2/ (local only)
